camel_example: aliyun live DescribeLiveDomainBpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn alibaba --EndTime '2017-12-10T09:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn tianjin --StartTime '2017-12-10T08:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Interval 300
description_en: Queries the network bandwidth monitoring data of a live streaming domain
description_zh: 调用DescribeLiveDomainBpsData查询直播域名的网络带宽监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-domain-bps-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T09:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en alibaba --location-name-en tianjin --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveDomainBpsData

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain. You can specify a single domain name or multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).
If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all live streaming domains is returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
播流域名。支持单个或批量域名查询。批量查询时多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。
若参数为空，默认返回所有直播域名合并后的数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。结束时间需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the queried data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:
300 (default)
3600
86400

If this parameter is not specified or set to an unsupported value, the default value 300 is used.
When the time granularity is 300, the returned bps value is the average number of bits transmitted per second within the 300-second interval.
When the time granularity is 3600 or 86400, the returned bps value is the peak value among all 300-second data points within the query period
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度。单位：秒。取值：
300（默认值）
3600
86400

不传或传值不支持时，取默认值300。
查询时间粒度为300时，返回的bps数据值为300秒内平均每秒传输的bit。
查询时间粒度为3600和86400时，返回的bps数据值为查询时间内所有300秒取值点的峰值
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP) in English. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to obtain the ISP name
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The name of the region in English. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to obtain the region name
parameters.name: location_name_en
